0.text: Use "+ Add" to register an RSS/Atom feed or a shortcut URL. Zenn, Qiita and others are available by default.

1.text: Create categories with "+ Group" and organize your feeds. Reorder them the way you like for a smoother daily routine.

2.text: Press "Refresh" to fetch new articles. Select one to preview it, and open it in a new tab if needed.
